title: cmdson v1
description: One document is a template for the invocation triple (env, argv, cwd) plus the typed choice space that fills its holes. A database file is an array of documents. This schema covers structure only; semantic rules it cannot express (uniqueness, cross-field exclusivity, typed defaults, positionals-xor-subcommands) are cmdson-lint's job — see docs/01-spec.md.

oneOf.description: Database file: an array of documents.

document.description: The root Command plus the two root-only fields: the version tag and cwd.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema. Root only; carries no meaning.

cmdson.description: Spec major version. Root only. Loaders reject unknown majors.

cwd.description: Working directory for the invocation (~ allowed) — the third slot of the triple. Root only.

name.description: Parse identity: what an SDK matches in argv and what menus display. Unique among siblings.

exec.description: argv TOKENS to emit for this node; default [name]. Always tokens, never a shell string — quoting is a frontend duty.

key.description: Keycap when offered as a subcommand choice in one-key frontends.

effect.description: Max along the chosen path wins. Auto-firing frontends refuse destructive unless the operator opts in.

params.description: ORDERED: emission order = document order. One list for flags, positionals, and env vars — bind discriminates.

subcommands.description: If present, exactly one MUST be chosen (the mutual-exclusion operator). Mutually exclusive with positional-bound params on the same node (lint CMD020).

name.description: Typed-result key (argparse `dest`) and generated-usage placeholder (<name>); never rendered into argv. Unique along any root-to-leaf path.

required.description: Asymmetric defaults matching CLI reality: flag=false, env=false, positional=true.

value.description: ABSENT = presence-only switch (legal only on flag binds; SDK result: boolean). PRESENT (even {}) = takes one value.

bind.description: WHERE the value lands in the invocation triple.

token.description: Exact spelling, dashes included — never implied. Dash-less tokens are legal ("ACTION").

join.description: How the value attaches: '--f v' vs '--f=v'. A render preference of the target CLI; parsers accept both. Quoting is NOT here — argv has no quotes.

var.description: The value travels via the environment: frontends WRITE a VAR=value prefix hoisted to the line front; SDKs READ it via getenv. One declaration, both directions.

type.description: Closed list. Booleans are switch-absence; enums are choices; everything else is `format`.

format.description: Free annotation ("path", "url", "email"): a hint for pickers/docs. Unknown formats degrade to the base type.

choices.description: Enumerated values. Bare-string shorthand: "s" is {"value": "s"}; loaders canonicalize.

open.description: Default: true iff choices absent. true = values outside choices are legal (choices are suggestions); false requires choices.

openPolicy.description: Consulted ONLY by no-free-text frontends when open=true. close = the listed choices become the whole set there; exclude = the list is mere examples, the param is unrenderable there.

default.description: PARSE-TIME: injected when the param is absent. Contract: emitting it explicitly MUST equal omitting it — this licenses finite frontends to pre-emit it. Typed per `type`; must satisfy constraints and be in choices when open=false.

initial.description: BUILD-TIME ONLY: interactive preselection. Parsers NEVER inject it. Use when the downstream tool owns the true default.

value.description: What is emitted (canonical string form) and what SDKs return. Typed per the owning Value.type.

label.description: Display text; falls back to the value.

key.description: Keycap for one-key frontends. Unique across the node's whole key surface. `-` is reserved for synthesized options.

meta.description: Opaque bags namespaced by frontend id (OpenAPI x- convention); unknown namespaces are ignored. Known: "tmux-oneshot" {autodismiss, key, menuName, menuText, window}, "karabiner" {omitChoices, skipKey}.
